locations.name: Bretonnia
locations.role: Large western cultural and geographic region made up of many decentralized kingdoms, duchies, lordships and other independent or semi-independent lands. Shared chivalric traditions, religion, language/cultural sphere and customs give the region a common Bretonnian identity despite political fragmentation.
One of the largest and most important kingdoms within Bretonnia, ruled by King Charles III. Proper name and exact territorial position remain undecided.
Capital of King Charles III's kingdom, hosting the royal court, tournament, markets, guilds, and major cathedral.
Seat of King Charles III and initial lodging/audience site for the Dragon Rider delegation.
Major cathedral within Charles III's kingdom and an important center of the religion shared across Bretonnia; exact institutional status remains undecided.
Site of jousts and associated ceremonial events in Charles III's capital.
Undecided location where the Holy Relic is recovered.
Fortress in which King Charles III, Alaric, and allied forces are trapped during Lothar's siege.
Territory within the Bretonnian political landscape proposed as a final royal reward to Alaric and the Dragon Rider Order; not yet accepted canon.
